newsitem.title: USA: Sports agent Falk in entertainment venture.
newsitem.headline: Sports agent Falk in entertainment venture.

text.p: Sports agent David Falk and Dennis Brownlee, chairman of direct broadcast satellite firm Space Station TeleVision, said they formed a venture to produce entertainment programs aimed at a U.S. urban audience.

The two firms formed New Urban Entertainment (NUE) Productions, to focus on the development, production and marketing of television, feature films and new media that will capitalize on the growing appeal of urban-based culture.
Falk Associates Management Enterprises represents such basketball players as Michael Jordan, Patrick Ewing and NBA Rookie of the Year Allen Iverson.
